title: Lowest Relief Installment a Plan May Carry
content:
Billing help center — **Patient Payment Plans**: the lowest relief installment a plan may carry after a financial-assistance release, set by the patient's award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program and the plan's payment setup.

## The rule

The floor of the relief installment depends on the award and the payment setup:

- for a patient with an approved award of 50 percent or more whose plan has automatic payments set up, the floor is **15 percent of the installment standing on the plan when the relief installment is set**, rounded to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounded up;
- for a patient with an approved award of at least 25 percent and below 50 percent, the floor is **30.00**;
- for any other patient, the floor is **the plan term's minimum installment**.

The relief installment is never below its floor; when the spread of the carried balance comes out lower, the relief installment is the floor.

## Reading the records

- **Approved award and its percentage** — the patient's case under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved, and the discount percentage of that award.
- **Automatic payments set up** — the plan's automatic-payment setting, whatever the method on file.
- **Installment standing on the plan** — the regular monthly installment the plan carries at the moment the relief installment is set, before it is replaced.

## Floor by award and setup

| Approved award's discount percentage | Automatic payments | Floor |
|---|---|---|
| 50 or more | Yes | 15 percent of the standing installment, to the cent |
| 50 or more | No | The term's minimum installment |
| 25 to below 50 | Yes or No | 30.00 |
| below 25, or no approved award | Yes or No | The term's minimum installment |

## Hypothetical cases (standing installment 210.00 on a 24-Month Extended Payment Plan)

- 75 percent award, automatic draws by bank transfer: floor 31.50 (15 percent of 210.00).
- 75 percent award, paid manually: floor is the term's minimum installment.
- 25 percent award, automatic draws: floor 30.00 — 25 percent is "at least 25".
- No approved award: floor is the term's minimum installment.
- Standing installment 96.83, 50 percent award, automatic draws: 15 percent is 14.5245, which rounds to 14.52.
